turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no budget-total metric, so I can't give a share of the budget. For 1 to 30 September 2026, ad spend was 6270 EUR and 4130 EUR of budget remained at month end. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
